AboutMe.title: About me 👨‍💻
AboutMe.message:
Hi there! My name is Carlos Vinicius — I’m a Full Stack Developer and Designer passionate about building modern and intuitive digital experiences.
I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development, and I'm currently pursuing a postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence. My work blends code and creativity, allowing me to design and develop scalable solutions that are both functional and visually engaging.
